basis: One current-type phenomenological adaptation state per E neuron; reference-voltage frozen-rate mean-current matching, not an exact two-state reduction.
effective_current: A_i = eta_M * M_i; units mV after dividing current by leak conductance
membrane: tau_m dV_i/dt = -V_i + I_Ei - Z_i I_Ii - Z_i G (V_i-E_G) - A_i
tau_rule: tau_quiet when causal global all-E R <= 5 Hz; tau_active otherwise
G_equation: G = 30 s_G; 0.5 s * ds_G/dt = q(R) - s_G
R_equation: 15 ms * dR/dt = -R + population spike rate; causal shot-noise update
network_lineage: Historical manual-core Z/G/K recovery network; not the later Fig4F xy_left_20 fitted network.
display_lineage: Fig6 reference_layout_20261011 only supplies plotting grammar.
carrier_metadata_note: Inherited tau_M_s/tau_M_ms and sahp/K keys in the historical job/applied_configuration are carrier inputs or inactive legacy metadata; the actual executed adaptation is defined here and in the frozen producer.
stationary_matching: For fixed R and neuron rate r_i (Hz), mean A_i = [0.0005 mV * 1 s + 7.68 mV * q * tau_A] r_i in continuous time.
lost_equivalence: Voltage dependence and shunting from K conductance
statistical_unit: One fixed network and one input/noise realization
